mapper.select: SELECT i.Instrument_ID, i.Symbol, i.Symbol_Name, i.current_price, i.InstrumentType_ID, it.InstrumentType FROM Instruments i LEFT JOIN Instrument_Type it ON i.InstrumentType_ID = it.InstrumentType_ID WHERE i.Instrument_ID = #{id}

SELECT i.Instrument_ID, i.Symbol, i.Symbol_Name, i.current_price, i.InstrumentType_ID, it.InstrumentType FROM Instruments i LEFT JOIN Instrument_Type it ON i.InstrumentType_ID = it.InstrumentType_ID WHERE i.Symbol = #{symbol}

SELECT i.Instrument_ID, i.Symbol, i.Symbol_Name, i.current_price, i.InstrumentType_ID, it.InstrumentType FROM Instruments i LEFT JOIN Instrument_Type it ON i.InstrumentType_ID = it.InstrumentType_ID ORDER BY i.Symbol ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Instruments (Symbol, Symbol_Name, current_price, InstrumentType_ID) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{symbolName}, #{currentPrice}, #{instrumentType.instrumentType_id})
